editorial:
Imagine being a typical teen who suddenly finds out you can cast spells, and then getting sucked into a wild, colorful world full of magic. That is exactly what happens to Billie, a girl who does things her own way and hates following the rules. She ends up in a place called Hexe, which is basically a giant playground for witches. The best part is that she has to bring her mom, Alice, along for the ride. Alice is the complete opposite of Billie because she is super cautious and scared of risks. Watching these two clash while trying to survive in a strange land makes for a really funny and sweet story about family.

You will love how the animation looks, especially the bright colors of the witch realm. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, and the jokes land well. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the emotional bond between the mother and daughter feels real.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Billie learns that her magic comes from her emotions, not just books. She and Alice combine their powers to stop the villain from stealing all the magic in Hexe. The big twist is that Alice was actually a powerful witch who gave up her powers to protect Billie. Once they win, they decide to keep a portal open so they can visit Hexe whenever they want, finally balancing their normal lives with their magic.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and family comedies.
